scenes.text: When the bathroom outlet dies and you’re about to call an electrician
scenes.label: NEW HOMEOWNER PROBLEMS
NOBODY TOLD ME  ·  PAGE 5
scenes.text: It’s usually not broken. Look for an outlet nearby with two little buttons, called a GFCI.

caption.hook: The outlet isn’t broken. It tripped.
caption.feel: Every new homeowner pays for this lesson once. You don’t have to.
caption.shows: A “Nobody Told Me” box from Chapter 1: what a GFCI is and where its reset button hides.
caption.ask: What’s the dumbest thing you ever called a pro for?
